From logo design and brand identity to brochures, social media creatives, pitch decks, and packaging — our talented designers deliver visually compelling, on-brand design solutions that help your business communicate better, attract more customers, and grow faster.

process.heading: Our Creative Design Process
process.subtitle: A collaborative, brand-first approach that transforms your vision into compelling visual design — on time and on budget.

steps.title: Brief & Brand Discovery
steps.description: We start by understanding your brand, business goals, target audience, and design preferences through a detailed creative brief. This ensures every design decision is purposeful and aligned with your brand identity.

steps.title: Concept Development
steps.description: Our creative team develops multiple design concepts based on your brief. We explore different visual directions — typography, color palettes, layout styles — and present 2–3 distinct concepts for your review.

steps.title: Design Execution
steps.description: Once a direction is approved, we execute the full design with meticulous attention to detail. Every element — spacing, alignment, color, and typography — is crafted to professional print and digital standards.

steps.title: Review & Revisions
steps.description: We share designs for your feedback and incorporate revisions until you are completely satisfied. Our transparent revision process ensures the final output matches your expectations perfectly.

steps.title: Quality Check & Finalization
steps.description: Every design goes through a thorough quality check — color accuracy, bleed margins, file resolution, and brand consistency — before final delivery. We ensure print-ready and web-ready files meet all technical standards.

steps.title: File Delivery & Brand Support
steps.description: We deliver all final files in every format you need — AI, EPS, PDF, PNG, JPG, SVG — along with a brand style guide. Our team remains available for future design needs, updates, and brand extensions.
points: All file formats (AI, EPS, PDF, PNG, SVG)

whyUs.title: Brand-First Design Thinking
whyUs.description: Every creative decision at Divrit Technologies starts with your brand — its values, voice, and audience. We never produce generic design; every piece is uniquely crafted for your business.

whyUs.title: Print & Digital Both Covered
whyUs.description: We deliver files ready for both print (CMYK, bleed, high-res) and digital (RGB, web-optimized) — ensuring your designs look perfect whether on a billboard or a smartphone screen.

whyUs.title: Fast Turnaround, No Compromise
whyUs.description: Urgent deadline? No problem. We offer express design delivery without compromising on quality — because we know your marketing campaigns can't wait.

whyUs.title: All Source Files Delivered

faqs.question: What file formats will I receive after the project?
faqs.answer: You will receive all final files in AI, EPS, PDF (print-ready), PNG, JPG, and SVG formats. For presentations, you'll get editable PPTX files. All source files are fully editable and yours to keep.

faqs.question: How many design concepts will you provide?
faqs.answer: We typically present 2–3 unique design concepts for logo and brand identity projects. For other design work like brochures or social media, we present 1–2 directions based on the approved style.

faqs.question: How many revisions are included?
faqs.answer: Our standard packages include 3 rounds of revisions. We also offer unlimited minor adjustments (text changes, color tweaks) at no extra charge to ensure you are 100% satisfied with the final output.

faqs.question: Can you match our existing brand guidelines?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. If you have an existing brand identity or style guide, we will strictly follow your guidelines to create designs that are consistent with your established visual language.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing monthly design support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer flexible monthly design retainer packages — ideal for businesses that need regular social media creatives, marketing materials, or ongoing brand asset production.

faqs.question: Is Divrit Technologies a registered company?
faqs.answer: Yes. Divrit Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a registered IT company and sister concern of Katyayni Technologies Pvt. Ltd., founded in 2017 with 800+ creative design projects delivered across global markets.
